summary: Cagayan 1st District representative with 11 principal-authored bills. Authored an anti-dynasty ban, a postponement of the barangay and SK elections, bills fixing their terms, an estate tax amnesty extension, travel-tax abolition and NIRC amendments.
caveat: Economic items are all taxation and so one issue; economics not scored. Postponement bills were widely co-sponsored.
